lines.en: My steps make the ground shake.

lines.zh: 我一步一步压近，地面发抖。
lines.en: I press closer, and the ground shivers.
My tail sweeps rubble aside.
I walk head low, nostrils working.

lines.zh: 我从洞穴的裂缝里挤过。
lines.en: I squeeze through a cave crack.

lines.zh: 我的后趾把碎石碾成粉。
lines.en: My hind claws grind the rubble to dust.
I am not fast, but heavy.
I stop and sniff.
My back rises and falls.
I turn my body, clumsily.
I crush a bone underfoot.
I head toward the smell.
I crush a bone underfoot.
I head toward the smell.

lines.zh: 我站在洞口，喉头一起一伏。
lines.en: I stand at the cave mouth, throat working.
I open my mouth, teeth showing.
I pant in the cave.
My eyes are small and bright.
I listen to the echo off the walls.
I bring my tail around front.
I'm grinding my teeth sharper.
I look down at the cave mouth.
My hide is rough.
I wait for something to come in.

lines.zh: 我把前胸压到洞底的高度。
lines.en: I sink my chest to the cave floor's level.

lines.zh: 我的鼻孔喷出两团白气。
lines.en: Two plumes of vapour leave my nostrils.
I grind my teeth.
I look up at the cave mouth.
You barely reach my shin.
I lower my head; that's enough.

lines.zh: 这种气味我没在这洞里闻过。
lines.en: I've never smelled this in my cave.
I could take you in one bite.
I shift back a little.
You don't run, so I hold still.
My teeth aren't long, but there are many.

lines.zh: 你站的这处，退路只有一条。
lines.en: Where you stand, there's one way out.
I tilt my head.
The hand on your weapon is trembling.
I lower my eyes to you and count to three.
Something rumbles in my throat.
Your bones are thin.

lines.zh: 铁的气味从你身上飘来。
lines.en: The smell of iron drifts off you.

lines.zh: 你手里那根棍子挡不住我。
lines.en: That stick won't stop me.

lines.zh: 我的鼻尖离你不到一臂。
lines.en: My snout is less than an arm's length from you.
My hind legs catch and I give ground.
My flank is cut open.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，血从牙缝出来。
lines.en: I grit my teeth and blood seeps through.
I shake the pain back behind my neck.

lines.zh: 这一下给我留了个口子。
lines.en: That opened a gash on me.
Every breath I take carries blood.
All four legs still hold me.
I retreat to the wall.
My small eyes stay nailed to you.
I dig my claws into the ground.
Meat. Fresh meat.
The piece in your hand.
Throw the meat. Don't hand it.
My nostrils twitch at the blood.
Do you have a second piece?
I dangle my jaw by your hand.
Not a mouthful.
Don't pull your hand back; I bite fast.
Stand back; I'm lowering my head.
I open my mouth slowly.

lines.zh: 你整个人撞上我的小腿。
lines.en: You run straight into my shin.
This bulk of mine doesn't shift.

lines.zh: 我挪开脚，地上留了个坑。
lines.en: I shift my foot and leave a pit behind.

lines.zh: 尾巴一扫，你贴到了墙上。
lines.en: One tail sweep pins you to the wall.
Don't press against my flank.
I push my head into the crack for you.

lines.zh: 两个身子在洞里撞闷了。
lines.en: Two bodies thud in the cave.
Your foot is wedged between my toes.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴把碎石推成一堆。
lines.en: My tail pushes the rubble into a heap.
Clear away from my cave mouth.
I am alone in this cave.
You don't even reach my head.

lines.zh: 这条岩缝里只有我一只。
lines.en: There is only one of me in this crack.

lines.zh: 我把下颚转开，看着洞口。
lines.en: I turn my jaw away, watching the mouth.
I still have to hunt.
No one climbs onto my back.
I settle onto the loose rock.

lines.zh: 我这副骨架不适合亲近。
lines.en: This frame of mine isn't made for closeness.
This whole rock seam is mine.
I close my eyes to a slit.
I take it up and chew twice.
That's not a mouthful for me.
I grind it down with my back teeth.
This won't chew.

lines.zh: 我一甩头，把它扔进石堆。
lines.en: A flick of my head sends it into the rocks.

lines.zh: 我鼻尖贴着它转了两圈。
lines.en: I nose it twice around.
Bone. I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 我用后脚把它碾进石粉。
lines.en: I grind it into rock dust with a hind foot.
I taste everything that falls.
I drag it by one end in my jaws.
You are blocking the cave mouth.
I lift my head off the rubble.
The blood on you hasn't faded yet.
My throat rumbled.
I drag my chest along the floor.
You crawled into my cave.
When I roar, we begin.
There is a rock wall behind you.

lines.zh: 我的前脚已经抬起来了。
lines.en: My forefoot is already lifted.
One stride brings me over.
Don't run. Running makes it worse.
My upper jaw lifts first.
My whole spine flattens.
My throat rumbles once.
I follow your scent.
You've gone behind the stone.
That stone won't stop me.
I break the stalagmite in my way.
I hear your steps clearly.
Half a block more and I reach you.

lines.zh: 我的下颚到了你胸口那么高。
lines.en: My jaw is level with your chest.
The cave pool is at your back.
The water is shallow; I can cross.
I snap a stalagmite.
One more step and you're close enough.
I crowd you toward the rock face.
I've broken two stalagmites.
Dead end behind you.
I crouch a little lower.

lines.zh: 我合上颚，肩骨在我嘴里响。
lines.en: My jaws close and your shoulder bone crunches.
I whip my head and you're flung.
A second bite.
A third follows.
My foreclaw rakes your leg.
You're slammed into the rock.
My teeth are in your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你举盾的手在抖，我看清了。
lines.en: The hand on your shield shakes. I see it.
I step back and shake my jaw.
I bite no more.
I bite a second time, teeth sinking deeper.
A third bite follows.
My teeth are in your shoulder.
I fling you onto the stone.

lines.zh: 我从黑暗里一步步走上地面。
lines.en: I climb out of the dark, step by step.
There are no claw marks of mine on these walls.
My steps send rubble sliding.

lines.zh: 洞顶太低，我蹭掉一块石头。
lines.en: The roof is too low; I scrape a rock loose.
I shake the rubble off my back.
I smell the wind outside.
I walk out slowly.
My three-toed claws hook the stone.
I open my mouth and the walls shake first.
I crush the rubble underfoot.
I begin circling the cave wall.
Someone passed just now.
Rubble rolls away under my steps.
The wind outside is cool.
I dig my claws in.
I widen the cave mouth a little.
Rubble still clings to my back.
The wind in this cave has turned.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的背，我往前冲。
lines.en: Fire catches my back and I lunge.
I fell and twisted a leg.
Water covers my head; I kick.
The blast rolls me onto my side.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我的肩胛上。
lines.en: An arrow is lodged in my shoulder blade.

lines.zh: 紫光进眼，我的脚步歪了。
lines.en: Violet light in my eyes and my steps wander.

lines.zh: 洞里已经几天没有猎物。
lines.en: No prey in this cave for days.

lines.zh: 雷落在我脊背，我整个人弹起。
lines.en: Lightning on my spine and I lurch upright.
There is no ground under me.
